d:
Eeran ke khilaf israil aur amerika ne jo jang shuru ki, usse rus ko kaee tarah ke fayde hone ki bat kahi ja rahi hai. eeran ke bandargahon par amerika ki nakebandi jari hai. isse ek or rus ko tel ki oonchi kimton se munapha ho raha hai. vahin eeran ka enarji market yuddh ke prabhav se jujh raha hai aur rus vahan apni maujudgi barha raha hai. kya eeran men apna prabhav barha raha hai rus? aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat.
